verified_provider_metadata.rights_statement: All content copyright Kera Mundari community (2013); all rights reserved; do not distribute or reproduce without permission.

scope_and_identity_controls.canonicalization: Treat interface pages, search-result pages, individual audio endpoints, mirrors and citations as manifestations of one underlying talking-dictionary resource unless provenance demonstrates a distinct source.
scope_and_identity_controls.language_qualification: Kera Mundari must remain explicitly qualified; do not silently generalize an entry to unqualified Mundari.
scope_and_identity_controls.independence: Dictionary entries/audio are one resource, not 446 independent sources.

rights_consent_cultural_controls.rule: Public listen/search access does not imply permission to redistribute audio, text, or metadata beyond supported citation/fair-use evidence.

promotion.reason: Provider explicitly prohibits distribution/reproduction without permission; item-level consent and cultural-access status are not established. Preserve as a verified but rights-restricted source lead.
promotion_gates: permission or documented lawful evidence-use basis

release_invariants_added: Kera Mundari evidence != silently unqualified Mundari evidence
community copyright != demonstrated individual speaker consent for downstream dataset reuse
